text:
Maya: Fog on the bridge + soaked scooter. Caltrans showing slow lanes. Anyone else crawling in? I left a spare umbrella and a latte in the kitchen (9th floor) — first come, first served :umbrella::coffee:
Aj: On the 101 ramp, creeping at 10mph. ETA +15-20. Might bail to the 76X if it doesn't clear. :sweat_smile:
Sophia: BART shows 'Minor delays due to police activity' between Embarcadero and Montgomery on my app. Taking the ferry instead — leaving from Ferry Building in 10 if anyone wants a lift. @Maya want the latte?
Maya: Yes please @Sophia :raised_hands: I'll meet you at the big clock by the ferry. @Lina are you still biking in?
Lina: I did bike but the underpass is a puddle. Towel in my locker. Also I brought an extra pair of dry shoes (size 8) if anyone needs them.
James: Caltrain's moving but packed. +12 on the board. Pro-tip: the SFO-bound express is actually faster rn if you can catch it.
oncall-bot: incident: transit_delay_1999 - Muni: 29x service experiencing slowdowns due to localized flooding. More info: https://status.muni.example/29x
Aj: Ferry sounds good — meet at Pier 1.5? :boat:
Sophia: Taking ferry, I can snag the latte for @Maya if she wants to save hers for later.
Maya: Swap plan: @Sophia you take my latte, @Lina take the umbrella. Whoever gets to the kitchen first, leave a sticky note. :grin:
James: PSA — Embarcadero garage pretty full this morning, FYI.
Maya: Update: made it upstairs. Left umbrella on kitchen counter with a sticky note 'for the soggy commuter.' Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
